name: Kimpton Harper Hotel
positioning: A Kimpton hotel in a 1920s building in downtown Fort Worth, with a 24th-floor lobby and a penthouse lounge
best_for: Travelers who want a downtown Fort Worth base with a bar and views

facts.text: The hotel is housed in a building from the 1920s.
The hotel is in the heart of Downtown Fort Worth.
The hotel's lobby is on the 24th floor and has sweeping views and a lively bar scene.
il Modo is the hotel's restaurant serving a contemporary take on Italian culinary traditions.
Refinery 714 is the hotel's penthouse lounge, serving cocktails.
Refinery 714 is named for the hotel's address, 714 Main Street.
The hotel's suites range from studios to presidential-style suites.
Pets stay free and no pet deposit is required.
The hotel offers free Wi-Fi and has a fitness center.

highlights.text: The lobby is on the 24th floor, with sweeping views and a lively bar scene.
Refinery 714 is a penthouse lounge with seating that looks over the Texas plains and downtown Fort Worth.
The hotel is housed in a building from the 1920s.
il Modo serves a contemporary take on Italian culinary traditions.

considerations.text: The hotel does not have a pool.
Overnight self parking costs 45 US dollars.
The hotel has no complimentary local area shuttle.
